name: Becca Balint

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: Rated 0% by National Right to Life Committee
Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

"Deciding whether and when to have a child is deeply personal – and should be in the hands of pregnant people, not politicians. The Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade was cruel, dehumanizing, and dangerous. It does not reflect the will of the majority of Americans who deeply value maintaining control of their bodies, their lives, and their futures. The extremist conservative Supreme Court is using their power to override the will of the people."
Voted against HR 26 "Born-Alive Abortion Surivors Protection Act"

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans

"It’s simple, if we starve our government of resources, we can’t meet the needs of our constituents. Whether it is Social Security or Disability benefits, I will not stop fighting for what Vermonters need."

"Social Security. Medicare. Nutrition assistance. Veterans benefits. Disability insurance. These are vital support systems for regular people and lifelines to staying out of crushing poverty. They need to be strengthened, not put on the chopping block."

"The GOP needs to find their way through their civil war and put forward a Speaker that keeps their word. We have urgent work to get done — from protecting Social Security, investing in education, ensuring reproductive rights are protected, and recovering from the flooding in VT."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "Billionaires should not pay lower tax rates than teachers, nurses, & firefighters. The Biden Budget will close the loophole that allows some billionaires to pay no federal income taxes. Working families pay their fair share of taxes. Billionaires should, too. #BidenBudget"

positions.question: Do you support a wealth tax in order to pay for public programs?

evidence.text: "Billionaires should not pay lower tax rates than teachers, nurses, & firefighters. The Biden Budget will close the loophole that allows some billionaires to pay no federal income taxes. Working families pay their fair share of taxes. Billionaires should, too. #BidenBudget"
"Oh, and let’s make sure the ultra-wealthy pay their fair share like the rest of us."

"Tax Day reminders: File your taxes. Tax the rich. Tax the corporations. Invest in working families."

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "Democracy is worse off since the Citizens United ruling 14 years ago to allow dark money groups to influence elections and policy. The agenda of corporations and the ultra wealthy has been able to bulldoze the needs of regular Americans. We need reform."

"It’s time to return power to the people. Our democracy is at stake. I'm proud to cosponsor @RepAdamSchiff’s Democracy for All amendment to overturn Citizen United and get dark money out of politics."
Rated 100% by End Citizens United

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "As we lurch towards a shutdown, Republicans are digging in on their spending bill that would mean an 80% cut in federal funding for low-income schools. It's a thinly veiled attack on working class people and it puts our most vulnerable students at risk."

"President Biden is an infrastructure president. He's investing back into Vermont through affordable and reliable internet, tens of thousands of new jobs, roads, bridges, airports, clean water, and more."

"President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act is the most significant piece of climate legislation passed in history. Vermonters will benefit firsthand from its investments in infrastructure resiliency."

"The Bipartisan Infrastructure Law — in just 2 years — has reached Vermont with: Cleaner and safer water. More people connected to high-speed internet. Improved roads and bridges. Better public transportation. Cleaner and more efficient energy. Upgraded airports. & so much more!"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "NEW: I just introduced the Community Housing Act. So many families are facing the crushing burden of the housing crisis. This is an investment of hundreds of billions of dollars into affordable housing to address root causes and alleviate long term affordability problems."

"The Community Housing Act offers creative solutions and bold investments to tackle the housing crisis in Vermont and across the country. It’s long past time we truly invest in the needs of working families."
"We cannot have a strong economy or communities without fair, affordable housing for all."

"We're facing a shortage of affordable housing in Vermont and in every state. Many households spend more than half of their income on housing — it’s not sustainable. We need to increase access and availability of affordable housing for families who need it most."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Because of the Inflation Reduction Act, the Twin States are receiving a historic investment to improve water and waste management. Water and waste management is a housing issue, a rural issue, and a community issue."

"President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act is the most significant piece of climate legislation passed in history. Vermonters will benefit firsthand from its investments in infrastructure resiliency."

"Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, million of Americans will save on average $800 per year and $2400 per family on #ACA health insurance premiums. Sign up by January 15 to #GetCovered starting next month."

"The Inflation Reduction Act made historic investments in growing our clean energy economy, lowering health care costs, creating good-paying union jobs & so much more. But we can't stop there. We need bold action. We need to pass the #GreenNewDeal and #MedicareForAll."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government allowing permits for drilling on public lands?

evidence.text: "The @HouseGOP is pushing a bill that puts #PollutersOverPeople. It's full of handouts and loopholes for their oil & gas and special interest friends – it does absolutely nothing to lower energy prices for American families or address our climate crisis."

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "American families are struggling while Big Pharma reaps the benefits. @HouseDemocrats and @POTUS have made major progress to keep lowering prescription drug costs & make healthcare more affordable. Let's build on that. Cap insulin at $35 for every American who needs it."

"Huge News: After @HouseDemocrats capped the price of insulin for seniors last year, @lillypad has announced capping the cost at $35 for everyone. Finally making insulin more accessible for anyone who needs it."

"Insulin is now capped at $35 a month for millions more Americans. This is progress — thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act — but there is more to do. We need to make sure that people can easily afford life saving medicine, not make drug companies richer."
